verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own programmatic, UI-free interfaces. The Query API returns the same calculated results as web-app reports, the Raw Event Export API supports high-volume exports, and JQL runs custom JavaScript queries on the query engine. Together these allow scripted, headless use of core analytics. However, the evidence never mentions CI pipelines, a CLI, or automation-oriented credentials, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration docs, documented service-account/token auth for unattended runs, a machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
